subject: Marine Works - Fraser River
text:
Marine Works - Fraser River
FRPD pipeline operations in the vicinity of Fraser Surrey dock rock jetty at 49 11.938N 122 54.339W. 
Hours of operation daily from 1300UTC Nov 17 to 0100UTC Dec 22. 
Vessels on site monitoring VHF Ch. 74.
All vessels are requested to make contact with RiverFlow Spirit upon approach.
